goal: Find one stable prompt recipe per model that produces images passing PIXEL_STYLE_PROFILE_2026-11-20.json.
common_style_block: Pixel-art CG rendering. Use dense 1-3 px pixel clusters to build every form. Use irregular, localized clustered dithering only in tonal transitions; never a repeating checkerboard or screen-door pattern. Use hard-edged color steps, crisp dark 1 px outlines, and rich pixel-level detail in hair, skin, fabric and background. Do not use anti-aliasing, soft airbrush, blur, smooth gradients, 3D rendering or flat anime shading.
negative_block: No repeating checkerboard, no screen-door dithering, no smooth anime, no 3D render, no anti-aliasing, no soft airbrush, no blur, no large unbroken flat fills, no photographic gradients.

variants.V1_conservative: Preserve the reference composition and render it as pixel-art CG with dense pixel clusters, hard color steps and crisp outlines. Keep the palette and lighting close to the reference.
variants.V2_balanced: First design at a low-resolution native pixel canvas, then upscale with nearest-neighbor. Keep visible 2-4 px clusters at final 2K. Use irregular clustered dithering only in shadow and highlight transitions. Use hard-edged color steps and crisp dark outlines. Do not smooth the image after upscaling.
variants.V3_strict: Design at a 640x360 native pixel canvas, then upscale with nearest-neighbor to 2K. Every form must be built from visible 1-3 px clusters. Use a limited hard palette, irregular localized dithering, crisp dark 1 px outlines, and high detail density in hair, skin, fabric and background. Explicitly avoid checkerboard patterns, anti-aliasing, soft gradients, airbrush shading and flat anime rendering.

seedream.suffix: Keep the 2K output crisp after upscaling; do not apply any smoothing, denoise or painterly pass. Preserve hard pixel edges and the reference palette.

openai.suffix: Follow the style constraints literally. Do not reinterpret the image as polished anime or 3D. Preserve exact composition, palette and pixel structure; add no new details smaller than one native pixel block.

grok.suffix: Render at a low-resolution native pixel canvas and upscale with nearest-neighbor. Do not repaint the image as smooth anime. Preserve the exact pose, outfit and framing; change only the pixel rendering.

tencent.suffix: One-shot generation from the source references. Preserve the reference palette and composition. Do not chain edits. Render crisp pixel clusters and hard color steps; avoid the model default smooth finish.

test_protocol.acceptance: At least 2/3 variants PASS_STYLE; median fail_distance <= 0.10; no uniform checkerboard by manual review.

prompt_assembly: content prompt + common_style_block + variant + model_adapters[model].suffix + negative_block
